job.title: Data Scientist I, NEST
job.pay_full: $108,300 – $160,000 a year base salary (Bellevue, WA), plus sign-on payments and restricted stock units

details.about: This Amazon team uses data science to help the company make smarter, faster decisions for customers, building analytical models and machine learning solutions that run at scale. As a Data Scientist you apply statistics, machine learning and data analysis to well-defined business problems, working with large datasets and science and engineering partners.
duties: Use statistical methods, machine learning and data analysis to turn well-defined business problems into data science solutions
Gather, clean and integrate large datasets from multiple sources to build and validate models
Design metrics, visualizations and reports that compare results against benchmarks and project goals
Work with business, science and engineering teams using tools such as Python, R or SQL
Evaluate where generative AI tools can be built into workflows, applying responsible practices
needs: 1+ years with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab)
2+ years as a data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst at an internet-based company with complex, big data sources
1+ years creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers or educational content
Master's degree in a STEM field, or experience working in STEM
nice: Statistical packages and BI tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS or R
Machine learning concepts; clustered data processing (Hadoop, Spark, MapReduce, Hive)
Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
Using quantitative analysis to make business decisions, and communicating complex concepts clearly
details.benefits: Base salary $108,300 – $160,000 a year in Bellevue, WA. The package includes sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs); final pay depends on experience, qualifications and location. Benefits include medical, dental, vision and prescription cover, life and AD&D insurance, mental health support, flexible spending accounts, adoption and surrogacy reimbursement, 401(k) matching, paid time off and parental leave.
notes: Workplace accommodations are available during the hiring process for candidates with disabilities
